title: Interview question sheet for a family member
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Biographies: conviction, justice and legacy
source: Seeded from english/y7 lesson 76 (Interview question sheet for a family member (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 76: Planning a short biography of a person of good character. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: complete the biography plan: subject, five facts, three events, legacy
questions.model: I do first: Subject: my grandmother. Fact: arrived in 1979. Event: started a Qur'an circle. Quality: generosity.

questions.q: plan a quotation from your interview (with permission)

questions.a: For example: What was the hardest decision you made? Why?
questions.model: I do: open questions start with what, why, how and cannot be answered yes or no.

questions.a: C) what the person leaves behind

questions.q: Name your subject and one quality
